# Luuna Rise and Power Cool frozen fixtures

These are narrow projections of accepted APK Protocol Audit report literals and
source attributes. They contain no runtime-generated expected bytes. Catalog
fixtures preserve all 8,966 / 8,623 accepted node identities and their getter
attributes; command fixtures preserve all 21,046 / 20,664 event/transport literal
records, including dynamic fields. Vector fixtures preserve the original 417 /
22 input/output definitions. Excluded paths remain evidence, not product APIs.
